experiments.expectedObservation: A successful archive open, root-folder read, bounded structural counts and explicit limitations; no message content

experiments.question: Can the approved representative PST be opened and its root accessed inside the existing sandbox, independently of the failed folder traversal?
experiments.expectedObservation: Archive open and root access, with no claim about traversal or extraction

discoveries.observation: The sandbox readiness probe passed, but the structural parser worker exited with a failure; product versus environment cause is not yet established.
discoveries.proposedEdit: Keep structural parser capability unverified until the worker environment and representative input are diagnosed; do not infer downstream schemas from this failure.
discoveries.publicSummary: A bounded structural-read experiment failed after sandbox readiness passed. Cause remains unconfirmed.

discoveries.observation: The bounded worker reached structure after archive open and root access, then raised OSError. The input was stable and sandbox probes passed. The cause remains unknown.
discoveries.proposedEdit: Distinguish archive/root access from qualified folder/message traversal; downstream interpretation and schema assumptions remain unverified.
discoveries.publicSummary: Archive and root access succeeded before the bounded structure walk raised OSError. This does not establish ingestion capability.

discoveries.observation: The real sandboxed representative archive opened and its root was accessed. No folder enumeration or message extraction was performed; previous structure-walk OSError remains unresolved.
discoveries.proposedEdit: Treat archive/root access as observed, keep traversal/extraction unqualified and downstream implementation details thin.
discoveries.publicSummary: Bounded archive and root access succeeded; traversal and extraction remain unqualified.
